observed_boundary.stock_read_fd0: Two runs emit ProbeReady/InputAttempt then SIGSYS159, no terminal
observed_boundary.container_policy: No network/devices/privilege; UID65534; readonly root/input; bounded tmpfs only for build
observed_boundary.qualification_scope: Capability-denial preflight only; no interactive exchange or TC0 conformance

proposed_transport.input: Explicit host-controlled pipe on guest fd0, Docker interactive stdin without TTY; never inherited terminal, host file or network input
proposed_transport.output: Existing write-fd1 path with a new bounded frame identity; stock tender banner is retained as explicitly allowed diagnostics outside semantic frames
proposed_transport.limitations: This is a stdio transport, not a new device ABI. Physically separate semantic/diagnostic channels would require a separately reviewed descriptor layout. Guest cooperative behavior is assumed, not enforced native instruction control.
proposed_transport.upstream_overlay: Project-owned pinned-source overlay, immutable new development image; leave vendor checkout and stock image pristine
proposed_transport.tender_change: Opt-in --fenrir-control-stdin flag that adds only bounded read(fd=0) to core seccomp policy; default stock mode retains denial
proposed_transport.descriptor_preconditions: Verify the exact input descriptor is an explicitly supplied pipe/socket, reject TTY and regular files, no open/socket/connect/new descriptors; record actual wiring and limits
proposed_transport.read_limit: Proposed per-read maximum65536 bytes, host cumulative/record/frame caps independently enforced; no arbitrary unbounded read permission
proposed_transport.guest_api: Project-only bounded read wrapper and versioned transport adapter, not a claimed upstream Solo5 API
proposed_transport.clocks: Stock clocks/yield/startup CPU ticks remain unmediated until S3; this transport extension does not establish D1 or D2

must_remain_unchanged: stock Solo5 image and historical evidence
next_slice_hand_expectations: Default unextended mode still kills fd0 read with SIGSYS
Opt-in mode Hello/Init then request0/response0 and request1/response1, Terminal/ack, clean exit
No next transition while guest is blocked awaiting its response; host delay changes no semantic payload
Only explicit recorded response bytes enter guest; replay uses the same responses
Malformed lengths, duplicates, wrong run/epoch/sequence/domain, unknown fields, early EOF/terminal and suffix fail closed
fd2/other-fd reads, oversized reads, open/socket/connect and ambient network remain denied under proposed policy
Regular-file or TTY input fails startup before guest execution
Watchdog/crash/output cap are infrastructure outcomes, not language traps or semantic kills
All owned process groups and containers are joined/removed, source/input identities unchanged
review_questions: Approve this opt-in fd0 policy extension and project-owned overlay, or require a physically separate descriptor channel instead?
Approve the fixed read/frame/aggregate bounds and diagnostic separation rules before freezing a transport identity?
Is cooperative D1 the initial goal, with arbitrary untrusted native code and D2 explicitly outside this slice?
authorization: Proposal only. Requires explicit human approval before implementing/building the expanded tender policy. No privilege, networking, deployment, evaluator registration or automatic drive renewal is authorized.
